# Pinnacle Verification Centre

> Source-led evidence for Pinnacle Blooms Network and Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited.

Source review: 15 September 2026. Selected originals and review conclusions rechecked: 18 September 2026. This site summarizes documentary evidence and is not a regulator’s certification service. Preserve the review status and scope limits when citing a record. A protocol is not completed validation; a management-system certificate does not guarantee a child’s outcome. Source review does not establish endorsement by the issuing organisations.

Evidence owner: Sourabh Sashank · Lead PinnacleAI® · care@pinnacleblooms.org · 9100 181 181.

## Pinnacle Paradigm Shift — nine care-system perspectives
- [01 · You wanted the car. Not a box of parts.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/01-life-in-view.html): The shift is in the architecture: measurement, planning, professional care, home practice and review working as one connected system.
- [02 · Separate reports. A shared starting point.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/02-shared-starting-point.html): A common ability framework gives each part of care a reference point for the same child.
- [03 · One child. One continuing record.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/03-plan-with-a-memory.html): Continuity needs a record that connects measurements, goals, context and responses across successive plans.
- [04 · Many specialists. One shared direction.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/04-one-shared-direction.html): Expertise becomes a connected system when the people involved can work from shared goals and context.
- [05 · Beyond the session. A connected programme.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/05-practice-in-everyday-life.html): A connected programme carries agreed goals beyond the appointment, with practical guidance for the people supporting the child.
- [06 · Close the feedback loop. Review. Correct. Repeat.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/06-feedback-that-shapes-care.html): A system needs a way to bring observations back into decisions about activities, support and the next plan.
- [07 · Tasks with a purpose. Participation in view.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/07-skills-with-a-purpose.html): Holding a pencil can be one target. Participating in a classroom activity gives that target a wider purpose.
- [08 · A plan that evolves. Eight views to review.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/08-review-and-reassess.html): A connected system has a review cycle: compare the child's present abilities, reconsider priorities and explain what should change next.
- [09 · Beyond more sessions. A direction for transition.](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm/09-independence-and-belonging.html): A developmental system needs a direction for what comes next: school participation, growing independence and the support that makes them possible.
- [All nine explanations and sources · JSON](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm-story.json)
- [All nine explanations and sources · text](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/paradigm-story.txt)
